title: HA-VLN 2.0: AN OPEN BENCHMARK AND LEADER BOARD FOR HUMAN-AWARE NAVIGATION IN DISCRETE AND CONTINUOUS ENVIRONMENTS WITH DYNAMIC MULTI-HUMAN INTERACTIONS
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and safety aspects of vision-and-language navigation (VLN) in robotics, such as collision avoidance and respecting personal space (socially compliant navigation). It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethical frameworks.
